categories.main_business_segments: Andes Technology Corporation primarily operates in the design, development, and licensing of embedded CPU intellectual property (IP) cores and related software development platforms and toolchains. Their business includes IP licensing, royalty income, and maintenance services for RISC-V based embedded processors and SoC platforms. They also provide custom computing services for tailored CPU IP design and integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on RISC-V architecture-based CPU IP cores, including 32/64-bit embedded processors, multi-core vector processors, and AI/ML accelerators. They develop proprietary instruction set architectures (AndeStar™), integrated development environments (AndeSight™), and security frameworks (AndeSentry™). Their products are delivered mainly as synthesizable RTL soft cores, supported by software toolchains and simulation models, without physical manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Their primary customers are IC design companies and IC design service firms that integrate Andes' CPU IP into SoC chips. End markets include consumer electronics, mobile communications, IoT, automotive electronics, AI/ML applications, industrial control, medical devices, and data centers. They also serve academic institutions with IP for research and teaching purposes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with key markets in Taiwan (38% revenue contribution), North America (31%), and China (23%). They have established business and design centers in Taiwan, the USA, China (Wuhan and Shanghai), Canada, Germany, and Samoa. They are expanding efforts in Europe and maintain a presence in Japan and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: Andes Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a provider of embedded processor IP cores and related software platforms. They supply IP to IC design companies who then integrate these cores into SoC chips, which are subsequently fabricated by foundries and assembled by downstream system companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on expanding their RISC-V CPU IP portfolio with high-performance, low-power cores, automotive-grade processors certified to ISO-26262 ASIL standards, AI/ML accelerators, and enhanced security features. They actively participate in RISC-V International and related ecosystem development, aiming to strengthen their software tools, custom computing capabilities, and global market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through IP licensing fees (67% of revenue), royalties based on chip production volumes (21%), and maintenance/service fees (12%). They also provide custom CPU IP design services and sell development platforms and software tools. The company does not manufacture physical products but licenses IP and software solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include ARM, Synopsys ARC, MIPS, and SiFive in the embedded processor IP market. Andes Technology is recognized as the world's largest RISC-V CPU IP supplier with a 30% market share in the RISC-V segment. They differentiate themselves through innovative instruction set architecture, energy-efficient designs, comprehensive software tools, and strong ecosystem partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.38 billion, a 30.6% increase over the previous year, marking a record high. Despite operating losses due to heavy R&D investment, they returned to profitability with a net income of NT$1.89 million. The company maintains strong cash flow and equity, with R&D expenses accounting for over 70% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented investment strategy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Andes Technology offers highly configurable, low-power, and high-performance RISC-V CPU IP cores with proprietary innovations such as AndeStar™ instruction sets and StackSafe™ hardware stack protection. Their integrated software development environment (AndeSight™) and comprehensive security framework (AndeSentry™) provide customers with a complete solution. Their strong ecosystem partnerships and global presence enable rapid time-to-market and tailored solutions for diverse embedded applications.
